Great game by yourself, and also with friends. A platformer game where you compete amongst 2~4 players to the goal of each map while each round, additional obstacles and deadly traps could be planted to obstruct one another.

Personally encourage making maps difficult, but at the same time, find the balance such that you don't sabotage the game experience for others.

Pros:
1. Simple controls and clear goal.
2. Each session can be adjusted, in length, and difficulty.
3. Great fun to play with friends.
4. Online multiplayer option for times when you want to fill in players.

Cons:
1. Random lobby matching could result in people grieving by making completion impossible.
2. The host of random lobbies can kick any player, that also means skill level of the player sometimes gets misinterpreted as hacking or unfair / foul play.
3. Anger management becomes an issue for when the tracks are too difficult.

Overall a great experience. A game you could always come back to, and laugh with friends

Always love this genre of game, Great game to play with friends, each round you all take turns placing one new object into the puzzle, the goal is to try to play to your strengths and the people you're playing with's weaknesses, make a level which you can complete reliably but still that others fail (since if nobody fails to reach the end, no points are earned). the result usually ends up being something incredibly hard to beat that'll test your platforming skills to the limit, what starts off relatively easy can get incredibly complex with tons of elements to watch out for as you make a mad dash to the goalpost.

If you're looking for a fun couch multiplayer game, this is it. Although there is online, it's not as fun because you can't hear reactions when you screw someone over.

The rules of the game are pretty simple - Every round, a box opens in which you can choose from a random set of 4 items. These items can vary from hazards to coins to platforms. The goal of the game is to get to the end game flag, while the others die and fail to reach the end. If you make it with at least 1 other person die, you get points. However, if you all make it, no one gets points because it's "too easy".

This happens until the map is overloaded, in which bombs will start to spawn in boxes to remove some of the hardness of the level. This will continue on until someone has enough points to win the game.

PROS:
- Simple objective
- Great controls (Can hook up xbox controller)
- This is essentially "Super Mario Maker competitive"
- Online servers are fluent (Some hiccups here and there)

CONS:
- No level up system (Makes me not wanna come back)
- Little to no replayability after you unlock everything

Overall, I give this an 8.5/10!

UCH is a multiplayer game where players build their own level step by step and then compete on who can beat it (the fastest). If everyone beats it or if noone beats it, you get no points, so you must make it hard enough for others to fail but easy enough for yourself to beat. It's a great game that is enjoyable with friends but also with randoms. Lobbies get filled almost instantly so there's hardly any waiting time for 4 players.
